optimizer.title: THE INDEPENDENT URBAN OPTIMIZER
optimizer.section:
After a busy day,
the time you spend at home should feel in tune

With LG AI Orchestra,

optimizer.desc: An urban dweller living solo who wants to manage their home efficiently

options.title: LG Sound Suite
options.desc:
Less adjusting, more enjoying.
Enjoy your favorite content with immersive sound.
result: After a long day, unwind at home with your favorite content.

LG Sound Suite uses Dolby Atmos FlexConnect, developed with Dolby,
 to automatically adjust the speakers and sound to suit your space and content,
 so you can simply sit back and enjoy a more immersive experience.
Experience premium sound made for your personal time.

options.title: LG StanbyME 2 Max
options.desc:
One screen, wherever you need it.
Enjoy your favorite content anywhere at home.
result: In urban living, one space often needs to work for both work and relaxation.

LG StanbyME 2 Max features a 32-inch large screen that can be used on a wall, table, 
or dedicated stand, giving you the flexibility to enjoy your screen wherever you need it.
Experience one flexible screen that fits your space and lifestyle.

options.title: LG UltraGear
options.desc:
Less waiting, more playing.
Make even a quick gaming break more rewarding.
result: When gaming time is limited after a busy day, fast response and smooth motion make every moment count.

LG UltraGear delivers a native 1000Hz refresh rate while maintaining FHD resolution, showing fast-moving scenes and targets with greater clarity,
 so you can react faster and get fully immersed even in a short gaming session.
Experience speed and clarity that help you get more out of every gaming moment.

options.title: LG Gallery+
options.desc:
Your space, your style.
Refresh your space to match your mood and taste.
result: The atmosphere of your space can change with your mood and tastes.
Experience a space that reflects your personal style.

options.title: Energy Leadership
options.desc:
Use Less. Live More.
Save energy without thinking about it.
result: Less Managing, More Living.

When living alone, keeping track of energy, water, and household chores can feel like one more thing to manage.

LG's AI-powered appliances learn your routines and help reduce energy, water, and time spent on everyday tasks.
Experience LG's Zero Labor Home, designed to give you more time for yourself.

options.title: Fit & Max Refrigerator
options.desc:
Fresh Food, Ready When You Are.
Keep ingredients fresh for longer.
result: Freshness, Your Way.

When living alone, keeping different foods fresh can be challenging.

The Convertible Drawer lets you select the ideal temperature based on what you're storing, helping keep ingredients at their best.
Experience flexible food care that adapts to your lifestyle.

options.title: Fit & Max Dishwasher
options.desc:
Enjoy Your Meal. We'll Handle the Dishes.
Easy clean-up after every meal
result: Clean Care, Automatically.

Even for a single household, dishwashing remains a daily task.

AI Sense Clean automatically detects soil levels and selects the optimal cycle, while QuadWash™ Pro and TrueSteam™ deliver powerful and gentle cleaning.
Experience dish care that works effortlessly in the background.

options.title: Fit&Max Laundry
options.desc:
Laundry Made Simple.
Spend less time on chores.
result: Laundry Care, Simplified.

When living alone, saving both space and time matters.

AI Wash & AI Dry analyze every load and automatically optimize washing and drying performance, while Heat Pump technology helps care for clothes efficiently.
Experience intelligent laundry care with less effort and more convenience.

options.title: Entrance
options.desc:
Leave Home with Confidence
Your home stays connected while you’re away.
result: When you're away, home should still feel taken care of.
ThinQ Claw recognizes when you've left and helps manage your home automatically, from energy-saving adjustments to creating the feeling that someone is home.
Experience peace of mind, even when you're away.

options.title: Kitchen
options.desc:
Meals Made Easy
Personalized help for every meal.
result: After a busy day, deciding what to cook can feel like another task.
ThinQ Claw understands your ingredients and preferences, helping with meal suggestions, cooking guidance, and ingredient management.
Experience an AI Kitchen that makes everyday meals easier.

options.title: Bed & Bath
options.desc:
Sleep Better
Comfort tailored to your routine.
result: A good day starts with a good night's sleep.
AI Sleep Care learns your sleep patterns and routine to help create a personalized sleep environment and support a better wake-up experience.
Experience personalized sleep care that helps you wake up ready.

options.title: Living
options.desc:
Everything in Sync
See and manage your home at a glance.
result: Coming home should feel effortless.
Home Briefing gives you a quick overview of your home's status, while ThinQ Claw helps you manage devices and settings with simple voice interactions.
Experience a home that adapts to your routine.

options.title: 30" Wall Oven
options.desc:
See Every Detail
Monitor every dish with AI-powered food recognition.
result: Even a meal for one can be worth savoring.
Gourmet AI recognizes what's being cooked and recommends the optimal cooking mode, while AI Browning helps achieve consistent results with less guesswork.
Experience precision cooking that elevates every meal.

options.title: LG SIGNATURE Refrigerator
options.desc:
A Kitchen That Listens
Access information and assistance with your voice.
result: Freshness should adapt to your lifestyle.
Simply tell AI what you're storing, and it recommends the optimal storage mode and settings to help keep ingredients at their best.
Experience personalized food care through simple voice interaction.

options.title: WashCombo™
options.desc:
Care Made Effortless
Premium fabric care without extra steps.
result: Your home should reflect both your style and your standards.
The new 24-inch WashCombo™ combines timeless design with AI Wash & AI Dry, delivering intelligent fabric care in a compact premium solution.
Experience fabric care designed to complement your lifestyle.

coordinator.title: THE CONNECTED FAMILY COORDINATOR
coordinator.desc: A home manager coordinating family meals and housework

The best family moments happen 
when everyone’s tastes and 
rhythms come together.

With LG AI Orchestra, 
discover how your family’s everyday moments 
come in tune with LG.

options.title: LG Sound Suite
options.desc:
More than great sound, more moments together.
Enjoy every family favorite with richer, immersive sound.
result: Great sound makes every moment you share with your family more enjoyable.

LG Sound Suite uses AI Sound Pro Plus to match the sound to your content, 
while Dolby Atmos FlexConnect, developed with Dolby, automatically adjusts the sound to suit your space.
From the kids’ favorite animations to the parents’ favorite dramas, everyone can enjoy rich, immersive sound together.
Experience premium home audio made for family time.

One screen, more moments together.

From a child’s online learning to family movie nights and smartphone mirroring, one screen can be enjoyed by the whole family in different ways.
Experience one flexible screen made for every moment with your family.

options.title: LG UltraGear
options.desc:
Play together, enjoy more.
Make family gaming more exciting and immersive.

options.title: LG Gallery+
options.desc:

through a variety of curated artworks.

bringing your family’s tastes and inspiration into the space in a new way.
